summary: Round-3 re-review: the carry-over minor from round 2 (trim-normalization and empty-value branches of the duplicate guard) is now fully addressed by the new test 'normalizes whitespace when comparing duplicates and ignores empty names' (spec line 157). That test mounts [onStart(), event('purchase'), event(' purchase '), event(''), event('')], asserts duplicate-2 IS flagged (trim match: 'purchase' === ' purchase '.trim()), and asserts duplicate-3 and duplicate-4 are NOT flagged (empty name → skip). This pins duplicateIndices' .trim() normalization (component line 89) and the `if (!key) continue` branch (component line 91). Litmus: removing .trim() in the component makes the test fail correctly; dropping the `if (!key) continue` guard and flagging blank-duplicate rows would make the empty-value assertions fail correctly. The spec now has 9 tests, the full suite reports 527 passed. All TDD Anchor cases are fully covered with behavioral assertions: add (entryStepId defaults to s1 per Decision 14), delete (two-click, on_start preserved), entry-step picker (sentinel+s1+s2 present, id-less step absent, labels include position), sentinel→step-1-id emit direction (picks __START__, asserts entryStepId=s1, NOT null), sentinel display (closed input shows sentinel label, locale-agnostic positive assertion), duplicate advisory (exact-match + trim-normalization + empty-skip), on_start visible + empty state. Migrated specs (keyboard.spec.ts, funnels.spec.ts) correctly updated to the triggers-array fixture shape without weakening: keyword-hint matching still exercises the real containsAnyKeyword path over the nested triggers[].keywords (component FunnelStepForm.vue diff line +25-28), and the store spec's summary/full factories carry the canonical triggers array that flows through update()/syncRow(). i18n parity spec covers all 17 funnels.triggersPanel.* keys in both uk.json and en.json, checked against actual locale files in the diff (21+21 lines each, no empty values). No issues found this round.
